partition_origin: Mechanical source-order midpoint recorded in GDT835 before word/rule capacity counts; not a historical chapter division
paragraph_unit: Maximal contiguous exact citation runs; disambiguate noncontiguous reuse by occurrence without merging or repairing labels
normalization: Frozen GDT832 casefold/ligature expansion/NFKD combining-mark removal; all ordered alphabetic runs preserved, whole citation run excluded if any alphabetic word is unrepresentable
annotation_policy: Exact written-word joins; MWT/unknown analyses remain unknown; new lemmas compare to union of all supported discovery analyses
reference: Unchanged GDT834 copy of GDT833 native Monarchia, fixed 12-suffix/128-wholeword candidate pools, empty family factors
unused_rule_policy: Absent from both splits is unidentifiable/unscored; every held-active literal still requires discovery support
stop_policy: Any fixed gate failure stops historical keys, ciphertext generation and fitting; do not change split, source, deck, reference, thresholds or words
